description: This Java source file defines an abstract class JdbcValueHandler with multiple nested classes, responsible for handling JDBC data types for database operations such as getting and setting column values in PreparedStatement and ResultSet objects. It includes type mappings, factory methods, and specific handlers for various SQL and Java types.
